topic: What beamforming strategies ensure consistent LOS connectivity for A2A links in dynamically changing flight formations?
consensus_response: To ensure consistent Line-of-Sight (LOS) connectivity for Air-to-Air (A2A) links in dynamically changing flight formations, adaptive beamforming strategies with Aircraft Trajectory Prediction (ATP) and Network Coding (NC) techniques are essential. By integrating ATP with adaptive beamforming, we can optimize beam placement proactively based on predicted aircraft trajectories, reducing unnecessary adjustments and minimizing interference. Additionally, incorporating NC techniques enables the merging of data streams from multiple users, enhancing system capacity while managing interference. This integrated approach ensures stable multihop connectivity among aircraft even in congested areas.
reference_context: Aeronautical communications involve A2G, A2A, and A2S communications at airports, populated areas, and unpopulated areas, requiring accurate knowledge of channel characteristics for designing and assessing performance. Dynamic beamforming schemes are indispensable due to non-stationary spatial channel properties in ELAA, impacting the portion of the XL array.
